inputs.name: apiKey
inputs.label: API Key
inputs.help: Admin Panel -> System Settings -> API Config

uploader.script: return async function(config, file, ctx) { const blob = await (await fetch(file.data)).blob(); const fd = new FormData(); fd.append('file', blob, file.name); if (config.accessLevel) fd.append('access_level', config.accessLevel); if (config.optimize !== undefined) fd.append('optimize', config.optimize.toString()); if (config.filePath) fd.append('filePath', config.filePath); if (config.folderId) fd.append('folderId', config.folderId); const res = await ctx.fetch(config.apiUrl, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'x-pixelpunk-key': config.apiKey }, body: fd }); const json = res.body; if (json.code !== 200) throw new Error(json.message || 'Upload failed'); return json.data.uploaded.url; }
